nodes.description: AccessControl.paused flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers
CMO role address, initialised to msg.sender at deploy
LuGoddess role address, initialised to msg.sender at deploy
CEO role address, initialised to msg.sender and changed by setCEO
CFO role address, changed by setCFO and by Use_EmergencyCode
COO role address, changed by setCOO
MoneyMoneyBank.Code emergency access code value
MoneyMoneyBank.Value required wei amount for emergency code takeover
Mapping from address to UserId used for identity of players/payers
LuToken ERC20 balance ledger keyed by UserId
ERC20 allowance ledger keyed by owner UserId and spender UserId
Auto game id counter used when creating auto games
Total supply of LuToken tracked in the contract
Global game round id counter incremented in game flow
setCEO(address) external onlyC_Meow_O, updates ceoAddress
setCFO(address) external onlyC_Meow_O, updates cfoAddress
setCOO(address) external onlyC_Meow_O, updates cooAddress
setCMO(address) external onlyLuGoddess, updates C_Meow_O_Address
pause() external onlyCLevel whenNotPaused, sets paused = true
unpause() public onlyLuGoddess, sets paused = false
Deposit() public payable, accepts ETH into bank
Withdraw(uint) public onlyCFO, transfers ETH to msg.sender
Set_EmergencyCode(uint,uint) onlyCFO, stores emergency Code and Value
Use_EmergencyCode(uint) payable, if code and msg.value match, sets cfoAddress = msg.sender
Exchange_ETH2LuToken(uint) payable, mints LuToken balances from msg.value
Exchange_LuToken2ETH(address,uint) burns LuToken and sends ETH via send()
SettingAutoGame_BettingRankRange(uint,uint,uint) onlyC_Meow_O config setter
CommandShell(address,bytes) payable onlyC_Meow_O, performs arbitrary external call
Worship_LuGoddess(address payable) payable, forwards contract balance
Donate_LuGoddess() payable, computes amount in loop and transfers to msg.sender
totalSupply() view returning TotalERC20Amount_LuToken
balanceOf(address) view returns LuToken balance for address
allowance(address,address) view returns remaining allowance
transfer(address,uint) internal balance bookkeeping move between UserIds
approve(address,uint) deducts sender balance and increases allowance
transferFrom(address,address,uint) spends allowance and credits receiver
Initialize_UserAccount internal, writes user mapping and emits event
Initialize_Game internal, writes Game_Unit struct and emits event
Bettings internal, records betting amount for current round
Initialize_Round internal, creates round and deals dealer cards
Initialize_PlayUnit internal, creates play unit and deals two cards
GetCard internal, draws a random card and pushes to Cards_Exsited
Im_Cute_RecusiveFunction internal, recursion/de-dup of card numbers
GetRandom_In52 view, pseudo random using blockhash and msg.sender
Counting_CardPoint view, maps card number to blackjack point
Counting_HandCardPoint view, accumulates hand points including aces
Determine_Result internal, decides winners/draws/losers of a round
Create_UserAccount external entry, requires sender has no account yet
Create_AutoGame external entry, creates an auto game for msg.sender
Create_DualGame external entry, dealer creates a multi-player game
Player_Bettings external entry, validates limits then records bet
Start_NewRound external entry, validates bets and initialises round
Player_HitOrStand external entry, player draws card or stands
Dealer_HitOrStand external entry, dealer draws or resolves/ settles round
msg.sender, used for role checks, balances, transfers and identity
block.timestamp (now) used as randomness seed in GetCard/GetRandom_In52
Arbitrary low-level call _Address.call.value(msg.value)(_Data) with attacker-specified target and calldata
msg.sender.transfer(_Amount) external value transfer to caller
_Address.transfer(address(this).balance + msg.value) caller-supplied destination value transfer
msg.sender.transfer(TransferAmount) loop-computed value paid back to caller
_GetPayAddress.send(LuTokenAmount * 98e12) ETH payout after state debits
keccak256(blockhash, msg.sender, seed) % 52 pseudo random card source, miner/validator influenceable
Dealer_HitOrStand balance statements like 'Mapping[...] - amount;' with no assignment, silent no-op settlement
Withdraw parameter _Amount, amount of ETH to transfer to caller
Use_EmergencyCode parameter code, compared against stored Code to seize CFO
Exchange_LuToken2ETH parameter LuTokenAmount, amount of LuToken burned
Exchange_LuToken2ETH parameter _GetPayAddress, recipient of the ETH payout
CommandShell parameter _Address, arbitrary call target controlled by CMO
CommandShell parameter _Data, arbitrary calldata bytes for the external call
Worship_LuGoddess parameter _Address, recipient of the contract balance
GetRandom_In52 parameter _Im_CuteNumber, user controlled randomness seed value
Donate_LuGoddess local TransferAmount computed by unbounded loop
Dealer_HitOrStand parameter Hit_or_Stand controlling draw vs settle branch

edges.reason: C_Meow_O_Address is initialised from msg.sender at deploy time, giving the deployer CMO privileges
LuGoddess is initialised from msg.sender, controlling unpause and setCMO
ceoAddress is initialised from msg.sender at deploy time
cfoAddress is initialised from msg.sender at deploy time
cooAddress is initialised from msg.sender at deploy time
setCEO overwrites ceoAddress allowing privilege transfer
setCEO guarded by onlyC_Meow_O which compares msg.sender
setCFO overwrites cfoAddress, controlling Withdraw and emergency code
setCFO guarded by onlyC_Meow_O comparing msg.sender
setCOO overwrites cooAddress
setCOO guarded by onlyC_Meow_O comparing msg.sender
setCMO overwrites C_Meow_O_Address, transferring top privilege
setCMO guarded by onlyLuGoddess comparing msg.sender
pause guarded by onlyCLevel which compares msg.sender against all role addresses
unpause guarded by onlyLuGoddess comparing msg.sender
pause sets the paused state variable to true
unpause resets the paused state variable to false
Withdraw invokes an external value transfer to the caller
Transfer recipient is msg.sender, letting a malicious CFO contract re-enter on receive
User supplied _Amount flows into the external transfer call
onlyCFO compares msg.sender against cfoAddress before allowing withdrawal
Use_EmergencyCode can overwrite cfoAddress when code and msg.value match
Successful caller (msg.sender) becomes the new CFO, a privilege escalation path
Caller supplied code is compared with stored Code to grant CFO rights
Set_EmergencyCode stores the secret Code used for CFO takeover
Set_EmergencyCode stores required Value the attacker must pay
Stored Code is read during the emergency takeover check
Stored Value is compared against msg.value during takeover
Exchange_LuToken2ETH sends ETH with send() to a caller supplied address
msg.sender maps to payer UserId used for balance debits
Attacker controlled _GetPayAddress receives the ETH via send()
LuTokenAmount scales the outbound ETH value being sent
CommandShell executes an arbitrary low-level call
Attacker supplied _Data bytes are forwarded verbatim to call()
Attacker supplied _Address is an arbitrary external call target
Worship_LuGoddess performs an external transfer of the contract balance
Caller supplied _Address receives the forwarded balance
Donate_LuGoddess transfers ETH to msg.sender based on a loop computation
Transfer recipient is msg.sender which can re-enter via receive fallback
Loop computed TransferAmount flows into the outbound transfer
GetRandom_In52 derives randomness from keccak256 over blockhash and msg.sender
block.timestamp (now) is used as the seed source, making randomness timestamp dependent
User supplied _Im_CuteNumber is mixed into the randomness hash
GetCard calls GetRandom_In52(now) to pick a card
msg.sender is part of the randomness input, players can influence card draws
Dealer_HitOrStand settlement uses statements that are pure no-ops, no balances change but round advances
Hit_or_Stand flag selects the branch that performs the ineffective arithmetic
Dealer settlement intends to mutate the ERC20 balance ledger
transfer performs raw subtraction/addition on balances without SafeMath, underflow/overflow possible
approve subtracts from the sender balance without SafeMath
Exchange_LuToken2ETH subtracts burned LuToken without SafeMath
Exchange_ETH2LuToken adds minted LuToken to balances without SafeMath
Exchange_ETH2LuToken increases TotalERC20Amount_LuToken without overflow checks
Exchange_LuToken2ETH decrements TotalERC20Amount_LuToken without checks
totalSupply returns the tracked TotalERC20Amount_LuToken value
GetCard passes now (block.timestamp) into the random card generator

normalization_plan.reason: The _Amount parameter only exists to size the external transfer to msg.sender; fold it into the withdrawal unsafe operation
The code parameter is only used inside the emergency takeover comparison; fold into Use_EmergencyCode
LuTokenAmount directly scales the ETH sent out; fold into the send unsafe operation
_GetPayAddress is only the recipient of the send() payout; fold into the send unsafe operation
_Address is only used as the arbitrary call target; fold into the CommandShell call operation
_Data is only used as the arbitrary call payload; fold into the CommandShell call operation
_Address is only used as the destination of the balance transfer; fold into the transfer operation
The seed parameter is only consumed inside the random generator; fold into GetRandom_In52
TransferAmount is computed locally and immediately used as the value transferred to msg.sender; fold into the transfer operation
Hit_or_Stand only selects the dealer branch inside the function; fold into Dealer_HitOrStand
